thread:
maria chen: Hey team — following the incident this morning (INC-2025-314), we promised a follow-up postmortem and some automation to reduce churn for future on-call handoffs. Can we schedule a short sync and agree on action items for the postmortem tooling? :calendar:

jon r.: I'm available today after 3pm PT. Quick ask — can the postmortem bot create the initial doc and triage checklist automatically when an incident is marked resolved in PagerDuty? That would save us time.

tara (oncall): +1. Oncall handoffs are messy when there's no canonical doc. I often get pinged about missing impact assessment sections. If the bot could scaffold "customer-impact" and "rollback-traces" sections, that'd help.

kevin li: We can do that. The bot already listens to the `incident:resolved` webhook. We just need to map fields. Proposal: Bot creates a doc with a template, assigns DRI to the responder, and opens a follow-up task in the PMO board. Thoughts?

maria chen: Exactly. Minimal template first. We don't want to block folks with heavy writeups. Suggested scaffold:

```
- summary: short (2-3 sentences)
- timeline: bullet timestamps
- customer impact: services + severity + affected customers
- root cause: short note + link to logs
- mitigation & recovery steps: who did what
- action items: owner, due date, status
```

sachin: Can the bot populate "timeline" entries from the incident timeline (PD + Slack deploy bot messages)? Even partial automation there will speed up the write.

luis: We can pull PD timeline + deploybot messages. Risk: cross-system timestamp alignment. We should include raw events and let humans compress.

jon r.: Also want an action-item dashboard. Right now action items live in the doc and slide into nobody's backlog. If the bot auto-creates a ticket per action item in the "Postmortem Actions" board with links back to the thread/doc, that'll close the loop.

kevin li: That is doable. Implementation plan:
1) webhook: incident.resolved -> bot creates postmortem doc from template
2) bot extracts timeline events (pd, deploys, alert timestamps) into the doc
3) when someone adds an action item (pattern: `ACTION: <desc> | owner:@name | due:YYYY-MM-DD`), bot auto-creates ticket and updates status
4) daily digest of open PMO action items to #postmortem-tracking channel

maria chen: Love it. A few edge cases:
- non-prod incidents should not auto-create a doc unless severity >= S2
- customer-impact must be flagged if any external SLA was affected
- preserve privacy for incidents marked internal (no external links)
\
tara (oncall): Suggestion for the action item syntax so it's human-editable but parseable by the bot. Example:
`ACTION: Investigate cache invalidation | owner:@kevin li | due:2025-11-20`

kevin li: We'll implement a simple regex. Also support quick commands in the thread like `/pm bot create-ticket ACTION-ID` to manually re-create.

incbot: [system] created postmortem doc: https://redwood.example/postmortems/INC-2025-314 (assigned to @maria chen) :robot_face:

maria chen: Nice. Let's make sure the doc template includes a short "customer comms" checkbox so Customer Success can triage outreach.

jon r.: QA: Who reviews automated timeline entries? We need a human verification step so inaccurate timestamps don't get published in the final PM.

luis: Bot can create the timeline in a "draft timeline" section. Add a small frontmatter check: `@dri, please review timeline` and bot stubs a reminder if not acknowledged in 48h.

maria chen: Ok, next steps and owners:
- kevin li: implement incident.resolved -> create doc & draft timeline (ETA: 2w)
- luis: PD + deploy timeline ingestion + timestamp normalization (ETA: 2w)
- jon r.: action-item ticket creation + board integration (ETA: 1w)
- maria chen: final template and comms checkbox, coordinate CS (ETA: 3 days)
- tara (oncall): validate default SLO/severity filtering (ETA: 3 days)

kevin li: I'll open a repo PR and drop the webhook contract here when ready.

jon r.: Could we add a `/postmortem draft` slash command so oncall can force-create drafts mid-incident for known large incidents? That would be useful.

luis: Good idea. We'll expose `/postmortem create --incident INCID --scope draft|final` and an alias `/pm create`.

maria chen: Timebox: let's ship minimal subset (create doc + action ticketing + draft timeline) within 2 weeks. After that iterate on PD filters, comms automation, and digest.

tara (oncall): Also want a one-click "request follow-up" action that pings the DRI and PMO channel. If an action item is overdue, escalate to the incident's team lead.

kevin li: We'll add escalation rules to ticketing step. Default: due +48h -> ping DRI, due +7d -> escalate to lead.

jon r.: For audits, keep a trace of bot actions in the original incident thread: when the bot creates tickets, it should post a summary message into the thread with ticket links.

incbot: [system] scheduled reminder: @maria chen to review draft timeline in 48h
\
maria chen: Thanks everyone. I'll set up a short 30min sync tomorrow to walk through the template and the action-item lifecycle. Agenda: template review, webhook contract, and demo of ticket creation. Ping me any blockers beforehand. :thumbsup:

kevin li: Thanks — I'll bring a rough PR and a demo of the slash command.

jon r.: I'll sketch the board columns and automation rules before the sync.

sachin: Can we also expose an endpoint for Compliance to pull action-item status? They asked for quarterly audits.

luis: Yes — ticketing integration will expose a read-only API key for compliance. We'll add that to the contract.

maria chen: Perfect. Closing the thread: postmortem bot improvements prioritized and owners assigned. I'll create the calendar invite. If anyone has additions to the template please edit the doc or DM me.

kevin li: Noted. I'll start the PR today.

jon r.: See you all tomorrow.
